proofDefinitions.inverseAstWitness: The four listed syntax-node replacements are inverted at their exact source locations. Restored blocks compare byte-for-byte to qualified R1 blocks, hence recover the same source for any fixed parser. Node-kind recipes are structural descriptions, not a claim that a compiler AST API or validator ran. Wrappers/signatures still require fresh independent V and parent strict TSC.
proofDefinitions.tokenProof: Supplementary bounded lexical spelling sequence, not a general TypeScript AST parser. Scanner alternatives in order: line/block comments; complete escaped double/single/backtick literals; identifiers; decimal numbers; === !== => ?? ?. ... && || <= >= == != ++ -- += -= *=; fallback non-whitespace character. Comments omitted, whitespace omitted; template interpolation retained verbatim inside its literal token. SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON token array, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',',':'). Raw equality is decisive and does not depend on scanner completeness.
